title: NEPA Data Standard
description: Data standards for the environmental review process conducted under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA). This standard provides a framework to ensure that all environmental, social, and economic data collected, used, and submitted during NEPA reviews adhere to consistent definitions, formats, and protocols.

project.description: Represents the activity or decision requiring a NEPA review process. A project generally has a relationship with a GIS object defining its location, which establishes the physical footprint of the action.

location_lon.description: Center/centroid of project (shortcut for plotting on a map - should attach GIS data object as well)

gis_data.description: Geospatial data and metadata associated with NEPA projects

container_inventory.description:
Inventory of map image container and GIS data container in json format (note inventory should be attached through gis_data_element objects, which may include a list of:
-	Format: GeoJSON, Shapefile, KML.
-	Access Method: URL, API, direct upload.
-	Coordinate System: Spatial reference system.
-	Bounding Box: Geographic extent.
-	Purpose: Bespoke, analysis, or base map.
-	Reference to database: Whether this object references an identified GIS analysis in an official inventory.

decision_element.description: Individual criteria or conditions used in NEPA decision-making processes

measure.description: A description of the type of thing being measured in the criteria (e.g. threshold of contamination)

intersect.description: If the spatial relationship is a simple intersection (e.g. floodplain)

spatial_reference.description: A container for reference to the screening criteria (e.g. api call for wetland data)

form_text.description: Text data to display on a screening form for a user to input data

form_response_desc.description: A description of the type of response expected on the form (e.g. text, select from list, number)

form_data.description: Formatted response for a formbuilder application (e.g. likert scale, number, etc)

evaluation_method.description: A description of how the response is matched against the condition and what the results could be.

evaluation_dmn.description: Decision Model Notation description of evaluation of decision element.

threshold.description: numeric value of the triggering measure (if applicable)

spatial.description: Whether the criterion is a spatial relationship

category.description: The category of the process decision element, such as limitation, condition, core, or extraordinary circumstances.

response_data.description: This jsonb field should contain the structure of data that will be returned by the logic engine - for example, if the response will be a json object containing a series of boolean yes/no indicators, this should specify the schema.

parent_decision_element_id.description: If this decision element depends on another decision element (e.g. if answer a is yes, ask question b), this field can be used to reference the parent decision element.
